rapier.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game, the attached OGRE holds a club painted the way this game paints weapons, and the attached LONG SWORD on magenta is this game's approved sword: match their rendering exactly (soft painterly, flat-ish colour with gentle shading, soft thick dark outlines, no texture, no background), and match the SWORD'S steel, brass and leather colours. SUBJECT: ONE RAPIER, an elegant Renaissance duelling sword, drawn as a game item for that farm man to hold in one hand. Its steel, brass and leather match the attached long sword, but it is a different weapon: slender and made to thrust. POINT UP, pommel down, symmetrical about its centre line. From the bottom: a small oval brass pommel; a short straight grip wrapped in dark brown leather, about as long as a fist is wide and a half; then the hilt, which is what makes it a rapier: a round brass CUP guard like a shallow bowl opening toward the blade, as wide as four blade-widths, with a thin straight brass crossbar (quillons) just under it reaching a little wider than the cup on each side; then a very long, very NARROW, perfectly straight steel blade, less than half as wide as the long sword's, of even width for most of its length and tapering to a needle point. The blade is about seven times as long as the grip. Colours: bright clean steel with one lighter and one darker side, warm brass, dark brown leather. Simple and bold: it is seen about 50 pixels tall on the board, so big plain shapes, no engraving, no jewels, no runes, no glow, no sparkle, no motion lines. COLOUR: never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. It stands perfectly UPRIGHT in the middle of the picture, exactly vertical, seen flat-on from the side: no tilt, no perspective, no foreshortening. It fills most of the picture's HEIGHT, with a margin of magenta above and below. ONE WEAPON ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no hand, no sheath, no shadow, no ground, no frame, no text. Every other pixel is pure solid magenta (#FF00FF).
